notes.title: Ver1.0.9
notes.content: Fixed a bug that sometimes caused invisible enemies to appear under certain conditions that were not originally intended.

notes.title: Ver1.0.7
notes.content: Fixed a bug that caused the back door to be opened before the front door was opened.

notes.title: PatchNote ver1.0.3
notes.content: Several minor bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Patch Note Ver1.0.2
notes.content:
・The guide has been added to make it easier to understand the objectives of the game.
・The electric board is now a little easier to see when viewed from a distance.

notes.title: PatchNote Ver1.0.1
notes.content:
・Adjusted the size of the electric board a little larger.
・Fixed a bug that caused unexpected behaviour when sitting on a chair at certain times of some anomalies.
